title: Don't Chase
briefing: A viral trailer has Pebble Games climbing day after day, and the feed is full of people celebrating. Decide what your plan says before the excitement decides for you.
objective: Recognize FOMO: measure how stretched a move is and wait for a planned entry.
debrief: The trailer went viral on day 3 and Pebble Games rose almost every day. By the "everyone is talking about it" headline on day 11 it was far above its 20-day average, and buyers who chased it there watched it slide about 15% when early holders sold from day 13. The release-date news on day 20 restarted the move from a much better price. A disciplined player skipped the stretched run-up and bought the pullback with a stop.
